skill.name: website-maintainer
skill.description: Guides maintenance of the Repomix VitePress documentation website, including locale configuration, multilingual content, and translation workflows.
skill.summary: Maintain the Repomix VitePress documentation website across languages and configuration files.

content.value_statement: Multilingual VitePress documentation is hard to update consistently across language folders. This skill guides Repomix website structure, locale config, and translation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the Repomix website directory structure and VitePress config locations.
Explains how to add a new language folder and locale configuration.
Guides edits to documents under src/[lang]/guide/*.md.
Points to navigation, sidebar, search, logo, and footer configuration files.
Reminds maintainers to keep English content as the source of truth.
limitations: It only documents the Repomix website layout and does not run validation commands.
It does not provide full translation quality review for every supported language.
It assumes the repository keeps the documented VitePress directory structure.
It does not define deployment, hosting, or release procedures.

use_cases.title: Add a new locale
use_cases.description: Create the required config file, locale entry, search config, and translated content folder for a new language.

use_cases.title: Update localized guides
use_cases.description: Find the correct guide files and keep translated pages aligned with the English source content.

use_cases.title: Adjust site navigation
use_cases.description: Update VitePress navigation, sidebar, search labels, and shared site settings in the expected config files.

prompt_templates.title: Find the right file
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find where to edit a Repomix documentation page for [language] and [topic].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a single documentation change.

prompt_templates.title: Update a translated guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the [language] guide for [topic] using the English page as the source of truth.

prompt_templates.title: Add a language
prompt_templates.prompt: Add support for [language code] in the Repomix VitePress website and list every required config and content change.

prompt_templates.title: Review localization consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the Repomix website changes for [language code] and check config, sidebar, search labels, and unchanged code examples.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before publishing localization updates.

output_examples.output: A checklist covering the locale config file, main locales registration, search config, and src/it content folder.
A focused edit plan for src/ja/guide/installation.md, with English as the reference and CLI options preserved.
Guidance to edit the French config file sidebar entries and keep search modal labels consistent.

best_practices: Use English documentation as the source of truth for translated pages.
Keep code examples and CLI options unchanged during translation.
Update content files and VitePress locale configuration together.
anti_patterns: Do not translate command names, CLI flags, or code examples.
Do not add a language folder without registering its VitePress locale config.
Do not change shared settings when only one locale needs a content update.

faq.question: What website framework does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports the Repomix documentation website built with VitePress.

faq.question: How many languages are documented by the skill?
faq.answer: The skill describes a VitePress site with 14 existing languages.

faq.question: Where should guide documents be edited?
faq.answer: Guide documents are edited under src/[lang]/guide/*.md for the target language.

faq.question: Where are navigation and sidebar settings changed?
faq.answer: Navigation and sidebar settings are changed in config/config[Lang].ts under themeConfig.sidebar.

faq.question: Does this skill translate content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and reminds maintainers to follow the English source content.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
